test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B complete a work in 20 days. If A alone can do it in 45 days, then B alone can do one-third of the same work in _______ days.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Work rate of **B** = (1/20) − (1/45) = (9 − 4) / 180 = 5 / 180 = 1 / 36.

Total time for **B** alone = 36 days.

Time for 1/3 of the work = 36 × (1/3) = 12 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A + B** = 20 days

Time taken by **A** alone = 45 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 **A + B** 20 180 9 
 **A** 45 4 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = 9 − 4 = 5 units/day

⇒ Total work to be done by **B** = 1/3 × 180 = 60 units

⇒ Time taken by **B** = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 days

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns Relation

The concept of Time and Work is identical to filling a tank. If two pipes fill a tank in T days and one fills in T₁, the other takes (T × T₁) ÷ (T₁ − T) days.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in the direct **ratio of the efficiency** of the workers or the ratio of work done.

Alternate Day Work

In alternate day problems, calculate work done in a **2-day cycle** first, then multiply to reach near the total work.</p
